ns2:section.sectionText: Students who have completed ADV 490 (Emerging Media) should not register for ADV 315. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop. Please note: Additional seats may be available to ADV/AGCM sophomores beginning November 15 at 11:00 am.
